overview: This Senate resolution supports naming April 2025 the "Month of the Military Child" to honor the children of service members and veterans. It notes that more than 1.6 million children are connected to the military and that joining the military is a commitment shared by the whole family. The resolution urges Americans to mark the month with ceremonies and activities that show support and appreciation for military children. It does not create programs or provide money. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on April 30, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution recognizes the sacrifices military children make, such as frequent moves and parents' deployments, and encourages communities to support them.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or provide new help to military families.
